note: *para sempre não serei envergonhado* = 30:2, the Te Deum line in D23's order. The stylist asks *não serei envergonhado para sempre* (heard as 'not for ever', D23); the Latinist asks the wish, *que eu não seja envergonhado*.
*falaram de mim* held against both Latinist runs (*contra mim*): 70:11's third person makes the words about him, and *contra* adds a hostility the dative does not say.

*só da vossa justiça* settles *solíus* as 'only'; the Latin also allows 'of you alone'. Both Latinist runs flag it; *da vossa justiça somente* leans the same way; option 3 spells out the other reading. Your call.
*pronunciarei* (as 118:13, 118:172); the stylist finds it technical and asks *proclamarei*. Proposed as a new open glossary row, for you.
*vos darei graças pela vossa verdade*: both Latinist runs say *veritátem* is the object. Under D5 *dar graças a* cannot take it, so *pela* is grammar (D2), as MS1932.
